§3Keep one Spacetime Anchor Beacon in your inventory to complete this check without consuming it.§r

Before departure, hold the beacon and Alt-right-click at a safe place to record its dimension, coordinates, and facing. It stores one return point; marking again overwrites it. In Prosperity, sneak and hold right-click for 3 seconds to return. Each successful recall costs 20,480,000 EU and starts a 30-second cooldown; a full 102,400,000 EU charge allows five returns. An unmarked, undercharged beacon or unsafe destination cannot return you. Mark it before touching the calibration core.§r
